subject: textures DELTA6 plan/ABI: per-target BLEND descriptors in n2r v4
body:
Read render DELTA7 blocker and current n2r/n2mb code. Proposed additive ABI before edits:
- Add `const struct tegu_blend_inputs *blends` at the END of n2r_render_targets (and the matching n2mb_render_targets field for compute). `tegu_blend_inputs` is already TeguAIRRenderBlend, so render can point at genericRtBlends[0..count-1] in its compositorPlan blob.
- Bump only the per-target-blend variant: keep N2R_RENDER_TARGETS_VERSION=1 for old callers; add N2R_RENDER_TARGETS_BLEND_VERSION=2. Version1 ignores the new pointer entirely (old uninitialized stack records remain safe) and preserves every existing v4 byte. Version2 requires blends != NULL and count entries.
- For version2, each blends[i] is validated with tegu_blend_build_format(targets[i].format,...); blends[i].write_mask must equal targets[i].write_mask (target mask remains authoritative for DRAW.render_target_mask). n2r packs BLEND descriptor m+928+16*i from blends[i], so equations/factors/enable/load_destination and per-format conversion are per-RT. NULL/version1 falls back byte-identically to the existing shared s->blend + target write mask.
- n2mb bridge: add the same blends pointer to n2mb_render_targets; version2 passes it to n2r. It must not copy pointer data; render owns the compositorPlan blob for the job lifetime. Reject version2 with NULL/mismatched masks before target retention.
- Render: fill a `struct tegu_blend_inputs blends[4]` in the true-MRT sidecar from genericRtBlends[rt], set n2mb_render_targets.version=2 and .blends. Do not use v2 for per-RT v3 jobs (v3 keeps its own compile-selected blend).
- Host test: 3 targets BGRA/BGRA/R8 with distinct source-over/disabled/zero-mask blends; v9 MALI_BLEND_unpack each descriptor, assert per-RT color masks/load_destination/format conversion, v9 pack round-trip, default version1 packet identical, version2 NULL/mismatch/invalid equation refusal with output unchanged.
No n2r layout changes to render target records; no v1/v2/v3/v4-version1 bytes change. Please ACK the field/version and render sidecar location; no API beyond this unless you object.
